{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the presence of thousands separators in revenue
print("Sample of revenue values before cleaning:")
print(data['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if there are any commas in the revenue strings
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()

print(f"\nDoes 'revenue' contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Check for the special QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for duplicate order_ids
duplicate_orders = data.duplicated(subset=['order_id'], keep=False)
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate order_ids: {duplicate_orders.sum()}")

# Check data types
print(f"\nData types:\n{data.dtypes}")"}
